verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
We pray for blessings
We pray for peace

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Comfort for family
Protection while we sleep

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
We pray for healing
For prosperity

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
We pray for your mighty hand
To ease our suffering

verse.name: v1e
verse.lines:
All the while You hear each spoken need
Yet love us way too much to give us lesser things

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
What if your blessings come through raindrops?
What if your healing comes through tears?

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines: What if a thousand sleepless nights are what it takes to know You're near?

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines: What if trials of this life, are your mercies in disguise?

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
We pray for wisdom
Your voice to hear

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
And we cry in anger when we cannot feel You near
We doubt Your goodness, we doubt Your love

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines: As if every promise from Your Word is not enough

verse.name: v2d
verse.lines:
All the while, You hear each desperate plea
And long that we have faith to believe

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
When friends betray us
When darkness seems to win

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
We know that pain reminds this heart
That this is not, this is not our home
It's not our home

verse.name: c2a
verse.lines:
Cause what if Your blessings come through raindrops
What if Your healing comes through tears

verse.name: c2b
verse.lines:
And what if a thousand sleepless nights
Are what it takes to know You're near

verse.name: c2c
verse.lines:
What if my greatest disappointments
Or the aching of this life

verse.name: c2d
verse.lines:
Is the revealing of a greater thirst this world can't satisfy
And what if trials of this lifeThe rain, the storms, the hardest nights
Are Your mercies in disguise
